title: Hankins, Michael — "The Korean War and the OODA Loop: What Happened to the Kill Ratio?" (2025)
citation: Hankins, Michael. "The Korean War and the OODA Loop: What Happened to the Kill Ratio?" From Balloons to Drones (blog), 3 April 2025.
notes: Author identified in search results as an aviation historian. Post argues the OODA loop concept is vague enough to support divergent readings, and separately disputes a commonly cited ~10:1 F-86-vs-MiG-15 Korean War kill ratio used in Boyd-derived commentary as empirical support for the framework, arguing the true ratio was lower (though still U.S.-favorable). Content reviewed only via search-result summary, not the full original post; treat sub-claims as provisional pending full-text review.
